textPrompt: Generate a visually stunning, professional 10-slide PowerPoint presentation titled 'The World's Most Beautiful Travel Destinations'. Cover the Maldives, Santorini in Greece, Bali in Indonesia, the Swiss Alps, Kyoto in Japan, the African savanna, Iceland's waterfalls, and the Norwegian fjords. Include an introductory title slide and a memorable conclusion. CRITICAL IMAGE REQUIREMENT: Every slide must contain at least one real, high-quality photographic image embedded directly into the PowerPoint file. The title slide must feature a breathtaking full-screen travel photograph. Each destination slide must contain a large, beautiful, geographically relevant photograph showing its landscape, architecture, or natural attractions. Do not use geometric shapes, gradients, icons, or text boxes as substitutes for actual photographs. Use authentic destination photography when available; do not present AI-generated scenes as real photographs of specific locations. Create a premium travel-magazine aesthetic with elegant typography, cinematic image compositions, excellent contrast, tasteful colors, and varied slide layouts. Use full-bleed photographs, split-screen photo-and-text layouts, large editorial image panels, and visually compelling image galleries. Keep text concise and informative. Avoid empty slides, excessive paragraphs, repeated images, irrelevant photographs, and blurry or stretched pictures. Ensure every image is physically embedded in the PPTX and remains visible in PDF and PNG previews. The final presentation should look like a professionally designed luxury travel presentation.
